message: TOWER OF FINIS

name: Synn
message: 「I'm firing! Melilot-san, please stand back!」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is futile.」
Inside Finis Tower, my panicked shout and Melilot-san's utterly cool-headed voice echo back.
Yes. The voices are definitely hitting the wall surface and bouncing back. There's no way this is just ringing in my ears.

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun, you have already executed five Spirit Arts attacks. Not a single one has broken through our predicament.」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe this sixth shot will do the trick!」
Melilot-san and I had gotten lost inside Finis Tower.
At my age, making such a childish mistake felt ridiculous, so at first I was laughing.
However, that amusement has completely vanished by now. I want to escape to the other side of this wall. Right away.

name: Synn
message: 「How about this?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Tch, no good again...」
No impact.
The offensive Spirit Art I unleashed trailed a long streak of light and vanished into the darkness.
It didn't hit anything. Even though there's supposed to be an inner wall right there.

name: Melilot
message: 「Your remaining Spirit Power is enough for roughly one more battle, correct? Please conserve it rather than wasting it.」

name: Synn
message: 「How do you--」
How do you know that? About to ask, I shut my mouth.
Having spent the last few hours together, I've come to understand Melilot-san's personality. She definitely wouldn't tell me.
A few hours ago, I came to the library by myself. Paqy was in the Student Council room, passionately hitting on Ria-senpai.

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, today I'll borrow this one and this one... two books, please.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then please present your library card.」

name: Synn
message: 「Here you go.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Oh, research books on Christmas?」
While writing the book titles onto the library card, Melilot-san strikes up a conversation.

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I thought they might be good reference for the Holy Night Festival.」

name: Synn
message: 「Also, if possible, I'd like to check whether they celebrate Nativity festivals in the Principality of Sharo-Ma--do you happen to have any reference books on that?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Unfortunately, we do not have any in our collection.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」

name: Melilot
message: 「You are looking out for Azel-san, aren't you? Thank you very much.」

name: Synn
message: 「? Why are you thanking me, Ms. Melilot?」

name: Melilot
message: 「No particular reason.」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Uh-huh...」
At Ms. Melilot's vague reply, I give an even more noncommittal, half-hearted response.
Usually, Ms. Melilot delivers her points concisely and with pinpoint precision--so what's gotten into her today?

name: Melilot
message: 「Here is your library card back. Your return due date is one week from today. If the library is closed, please drop the books in the return slot by the entrance.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, thank you.」
Giving a polite nod at the familiar spiel, I exit the library.
I'm a little worried about Ms. Melilot, too, but I've got a mountain of other pressing problems that need to take priority.
The Student Council. The Crusaders. Me being the Demon Lord. The Holy Night Festival. And Azel, who still hasn't warmed up to everyone yet.

name: Melilot
message: 「Did you forget something?」

name: Synn
message: 「E-Excuse me!」

name: Synn
message: 「I can't get out of the library?! That's impossible!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I see. A fascinating phenomenon. Allow me to try as well.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yikes?!」
This time, the instant the library door opened, we stepped straight out into the board chairman's office.

name: Melilot
message: 「Hmm, things have gone haywire.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What's going on here?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Space has become unstable. It may be an effect of Re-Crea.」

name: Synn
message: 「You know about Re-Crea?!」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is a hobby of mine. I have been researching it for many years.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel?」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel, wait」

name: Melilot
message: 「He went inside Finis Tower, didn't he. Entry is prohibited by school regulations--how troublesome.」

name: Synn
message: 「Could Azel be confused by all this just like us? I'll go call him back!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I will go. Sakura-kun, please report this to Helena.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel is my classmate.」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Understood. Then let the two of us go after him.」
And so, without managing to find Azel, we ended up getting lost...

name: Melilot
message: 「Let us steadily try to escape. It will take time, but in situations like this, if we keep a hand on the wall as we advance, we are sure to reach the exit.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-yes. Though, we've been climbing stairs for a while now. I wonder what floor we're on...」

name: Melilot
message: 「No, I have been going down stairs this whole time?」
How long has it been since we started searching for Azel? I don't have a watch.
Melilot-san's cell phone ran out of battery long ago.
Maybe because we've been in the dark for so long, my sense of time has gotten hazy.
It feels like only ten minutes have passed since we stepped into the tower, yet it also feels like we've been trapped here for dozens of days.
Strangely enough, I don't feel hungry. I don't get sleepy either. However, my guardian angel's Spirit Power, which normally recovers gradually, has remained depleted.
If I release the Demon Lord's power, we might be able to escape... but I don't know how to become the Demon Lord.

name: Synn
message: 「Where is it... the wall...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Hyaaah!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Wh-where are you touching!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, could that just now be--」

name: Melilot
message: 「I will not forgive you if you take advantage of the confusion to do anything weird!!」

name: Synn
message: 「E-even if you say that, I can't even see my own hands, let alone my feet-aaah!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Kyaaaah!!」
I fell down with a thud, and where I landed was something soft that smelled nice.
C-could this be Melilot-san's...!!

name: Melilot
message: 「H-hey... Sakura-kun!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmph, mmmph!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ah, n-no... not there... ngh, mmm~~!」
B-bad... I'm starting to feel kind of weird...
Wait, no, no!
I put my hands down to get up, but--

name: Melilot
message: 「Aaah!! N-No, any further than that... I-I won't forgive you, ah, nn. Nnaah」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, I couldn't help it--」

name: Melilot
message: 「E-Even with an excuse like that, your fingers are still moving--」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? I'm not doing anything with my fingers...」
Even as we say that, Melilot-san's body is pulled away from my hands.

name: Melilot
message: 「S-Sakura-kun...? W-Where are you going?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Aren't you the one running away, Melilot-san--」

name: Melilot
message: 「No. I'm not doing any such--wait, then whose hands are these!!」

name: Synn
message: 「!? Melilot-san!!」
I reach out frantically, but I fail to catch hold of Melilot-san.

name: Melilot
message: 「Kyah, st-stop it! Ah, ugh, uuugh!!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey!! What are you doing to Melilot-san! Tch, wait!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I-I'm fine, Sakura-kun... I'll manage somehow on my own--」

name: Melilot
message: 「St-Stop it! Ah... kyaaaaah!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san!!」
N-No way... was Melilot-san abducted by someone!!

name: Synn
message: 「Tch!! Wait!! Give Melilot-san back!!」
However, my voice doesn't reach anywhere inside the tower.
Could it be... Azel!?
But what for...
No!! The truth is still shrouded in darkness. Azel might have been abducted just like Melilot-san, too.
What should I do?
Either way, I can't just die like a dog here.
Let's explore this tower.
I'm going to make it back alive!
Thus, the curtain rises on an endless adventure.
Will I actually be able to reach the top floor of the tower...?
